meta.source: aoestats.io public weekly database dumps (players.parquet with replay_summary_raw, matches.parquet)
meta.windows: 2023-09-17 to 2024-02-04 (main) and 2023-06-04 to 2023-06-25 (spring), pooled for estimates and used separately for replication
meta.filters: 1v1 random map, replay-enhanced, civs differ, both players rated 1200+, at least 10 minutes; army excludes villagers, trade, siege, ships, monks

tests.all: whole-game production, 40+ army units each, no age condition
tests.imp: both players reached Imperial Age; Castle+Imperial production only, 40+ army units each
tests.cas: both players reached Imperial Age; Castle Age production only (the choice made before the outcome is clear), 20+ army units each

meta.heavy_definition: unit >= 30% of the army units in the test's period (and >= 10 built); light = <= 5%
meta.adjustment: win rate vs the Elo-expected win rate, stratified by game length (10-20, 20-30, 30-40, 40-50, 50+ min); comparison is within the same civ
meta.why_not_newer: aoestats.io dumps contain unit data only up to Feb 2024; every dump after 2026-02-07 is empty and replay data ends Feb 2024
